description: S56, recorded again in S68: games from the start of each 3-player preset that reach every end in its table (decision 0016), under the current versions (draft-3p 0.4.0, standard-3p 0.3.0, easy-3p 0.2.0), where each Coast piece first leaves the Coast through A5 (decision 0019). The Standard games were recorded again in S71 under 0.3.0, where the Dragon's pieces attack nothing from the Coast and Kings and Queens may capture them there (decision 0020); the 0.2.0 games are in three-player-ends-before-s71.json. Found by seeded self-play with a policy that takes the wanted win or event and avoids the others (the Good Practice checkmate between Kings: Dark searching at depth 2 against random play); the moves are what the test replays, so the seed is only for reference. The games recorded before S68 are in three-player-ends-before-s68.json. Rows: kinged-checkmates-king, dragon-captures-king, duel-dragon-wins, duel-kinged-wins, tail-stone, dragon-out, draw-both-kings, draw-duel; Easy Start: kinged-checkmates-king, kinged-checkmates-tail, dragon-checkmates-king, draw.
